world_skills.name: Climbing
world_skills.description: Scale walls, cliffs, and obstacles. Opens paths others can't reach.

world_skills.name: Persuasion
world_skills.description: Convince others through words and charm. Talk your way out of danger.

world_skills.name: Lockpicking
world_skills.description: Open locked doors and chests. Access hidden treasures and shortcuts.

world_skills.name: Athletics
world_skills.description: Feats of strength and endurance. Move heavy objects, swim, run.

world_skills.name: Perception
world_skills.description: Notice hidden details, traps, and clues others miss.

world_skills.name: Stealth
world_skills.description: Move unseen and unheard. Avoid encounters and eavesdrop.

world_skills.name: Survival
world_skills.description: Track creatures, find food, and navigate wilderness terrain.

world_skills.name: Arcana
world_skills.description: Knowledge of magic, enchantments, and supernatural phenomena.

world_skills.name: Medicine
world_skills.description: Treat wounds, identify poisons, and stabilize the injured.

world_skills.name: Intimidation
world_skills.description: Threaten and coerce others through fear and force of will.

world_skills.name: History
world_skills.description: Recall lore about places, people, and events of the past.

world_skills.name: Animal Handling
world_skills.description: Calm, train, and communicate with beasts and mounts.

world_skills.name: Performance
world_skills.description: Entertain, inspire, and distract through song, dance, or story.
